hypothesis: The approximately 31 degree target-relative root mismatch at the first active-standing policy inference is a causal driver of the RealOnnxPolicy collapse. Removing only that rigid global mismatch should improve the policy input distribution and the locked standing-plant metrics without changing target readback.
competing_explanations: The root mismatch is a valid recovery error signal expected by the policy rather than an erroneous coordinate offset.
An independent observation/action frame, action decoding, or Manny constraint-frame error dominates the collapse even when the root mismatch is removed.

single_changed_variable.name: active_standing_future_target_rigid_root_alignment
single_changed_variable.scope: WITH_DEV_AUTOMATION_TESTS and RealOnnxPolicy and BalanceActive_Standing only
single_changed_variable.capture_rule: At the first BalanceActive_Standing policy update, rigidly map the first canonical future root to the live canonical root and freeze that transform for the run.

expected_if_hypothesis_correct: The first active-standing target-relative root approaches identity, normalized first-slice target outliers decrease, and at least the pelvis-height, root-tilt, or body-speed metrics improve while target readback remains unchanged.
falsification_observation: The override corrects the measured target-root mismatch and input-distribution outliers, but locked standing behavior remains equal or becomes worse with unchanged target readback.

implementation.commit_subject: Add test-only standing target root alignment

conclusion.summary: The one-time rigid alignment successfully removed the measured first active-standing root mismatch and all greater-than-five-sigma target-position and target-rotation outliers. Standing nevertheless became materially worse and acquired root-angular-speed and support-gap failures while target readback remained perfect. The approximately 31 degree mismatch is therefore not, by itself, the causal explanation for collapse; it may be a meaningful recovery signal, or an independent action/constraint semantic error may dominate.

next_highest_information_experiment.hypothesis: The remaining collapse is caused by a mismatch between ProtoMotions joint-action semantics and the joint-local Manny constraint frames used to publish Physics Control targets.
next_highest_information_experiment.first_step: Add instrumentation that records, for the first active-standing inference, each raw Proto action triplet, its decoded SMPL local rotation, the mapped Manny constraint-frame target, authored constraint axes and limits, and the applied/read-back target.
next_highest_information_experiment.single_variable_for_followup_behavior_te: After instrumentation proves a specific frame mismatch, change only that identified joint-frame transform behind a development-only override.
primary_semantic_metrics: limit occupancy and sign consistency for bilateral joint pairs
next_highest_information_experiment.required_ab: Rerun the unchanged RealOnnxPolicy baseline beside the single joint-frame correction using the same commit, seed, timestep, initial pose, capture window, and evaluator.
